148	/// Built only through [`ParsedProp::new`], which makes a prop with a default value optional:

152	///
153	/// let prop = ParsedProp::new("x".into(), PropType::String, true, None, String::new(), Default::default(), None, vec![]);

174	#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]

178	    /// Resolved semantic type

181	    /// Whether the prop is required

195	    /// type the resolver evaluated in full. Derived from `prop_type`, so it never disagrees with it, with one addition:

197	    /// the kinds of what the checker could not read, since the checker did not confirm the type.

214	    /// Feed `hasher` everything `==` compares, so equal props hash equal (`ResolutionContext::share`).
215	    pub(crate) fn structural_hash<H: std::hash::Hasher>(&self, hasher: &mut H) {
216	        use std::hash::Hash;
217	        self.name.hash(hasher);
218	        self.prop_type.structural_hash(hasher);
219	        self.required.hash(hasher);
220	        if let Some(default) = &self.default_value {
221	            default.value.hash(hasher);
222	            default.computed.hash(hasher);
223	        }
224	        self.description.hash(hasher);
225	        self.tags.hash(hasher);
226	        for parent in self.parent.iter().chain(&self.declarations) {
227	            parent.name.hash(hasher);
228	            parent.file_name.hash(hasher);
229	        }
230	    }

233	    pub(crate) fn with_default_value(&self, default_value: DefaultValue) -> ParsedProp {

236	            self.prop_type.clone(),
237	            self.required,

248	    /// prop effectively optional regardless of what `required` was computed
249	    /// as upstream (e.g. a destructured param with both a type annotation
250	    /// marking it required and a default expression).

257	        description: String,
258	        tags: BTreeMap<String, String>,
259	        parent: Option<PropParent>,
260	        declarations: Vec<PropParent>,

262	        let required = if default_value.is_some() { false } else { required };
263	        let degraded_by = prop_type.degraded_by().into_iter().map(str::to_owned).collect();

265	            name,
266	            prop_type,
267	            required,
268	            default_value,
269	            description,
270	            tags,
271	            parent,
272	            declarations,
273	            degraded_by,
